scripts.deploy:comment: By hand for now, with your own `wrangler login`. Run it with `pnpm --filter slab-site run deploy`, since a bare `deploy` is pnpm's own command. Once Workers Builds is connected to the repository, it builds and deploys on every push to main instead.
scripts.og: astro build && pnpm og:generate && astro build
scripts.og:comment: The cards are read from the built pages, so the site's built first, then again so they're copied into it.
